title: Machine learning prioritizes FABP4 as a platinum-resistance factor in ovarian cancer
summary: Machine-learning algorithms (XGBoost, Lasso, random forest) applied to the GSE51373 transcriptomic set ranked FABP4 as a top platinum-resistance biomarker (AUC 0.861, 95% CI 0.782-0.940). In resistant cell lines, FABP4 was upregulated, and its knockdown suppressed proliferation and xenograft tumor growth in nude mice, raised ROS and increased cisplatin-induced apoptosis. FABP4 was associated with ferroptosis-marker changes, but the screening used one public dataset and the mechanism is associative.
ai_technology: XGBoost, Lasso and random forest used to prioritize resistance-associated genes
organization: Fourth Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University

evidence.tested: FABP4 knockdown in resistant cell lines and nude mouse xenografts after computational screening.
evidence.unknown: Validation of the screening beyond one GEO dataset; causal ferroptosis mechanism and clinical relevance; full text not reviewed.
